commodity_category_coverage.join_rule: A City Record PIN is joined to a PASSPort Public RFx EPIN by exact alphanumeric match, one trailing letter-and-digits suffix stripped, the PIN as a prefix of the EPIN, or the EPIN as a prefix of the PIN. The RFx main commodity is an L3 category only when its label matches a City commodity category exactly after normalizing case and spacing. No PIN, no join, two RFx rows for the same EPIN that disagree, or a label that is not an L3 category is published as category not published, with the reason. Nothing is guessed.

work_site_coverage.rule: A street address in the notice text is a work site only when the notice presents it as the place of the work: it is in the notice title, it follows a LOCATION label that is not part of a pre-bid meeting block, or its sentence says the work, project or facility is located at it. Addresses where bids are delivered or opened, where documents are collected, where a pre-bid meeting or site tour is held, where an agency office sits, or whose role the sentence does not say are never work sites. A work-site address is geocoded in the City Planning Property Address Directory snapshot, placed on its tax-lot point, and joined to the community district whose boundary contains the point. No vendor field, agency name or bare borough is used. Nothing is guessed. Each placed address is labelled from the typed role that sentence supports: "Work site", "Delivery site", or "Property in this solicitation". When a LOCATION line names a facility the notice title already names, the quote is the street address as written.
